items.headline: Panthers RT Moton coughed up blood before clot diagnosis
items.description: Carolina Panthers right tackle Taylor Moton, 32, told reporters Tuesday that he coughed up blood before being diagnosed with multiple blood clots in June, an ailment that sidelined him through training camp and into the second month of the regular season.
